subject: Coord: Executive demo — propose staggered VP/CTO windows
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@stellatek.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jul 2029 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro & demo — availability for VP/CTO?

Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the call last week. As discussed, we’d like to schedule a 45–60 minute demo focused on your platform’s high-throughput inference use cases and the cost/latency trade-offs we can help optimize. It would be ideal to include your VP of Engineering or CIO and the CTO if possible for the first 20–30 minutes for strategy alignment, then a deeper technical runthrough for the rest.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 23, 10:00–11:00 or 11:30–12:30
- Wed Jul 24, 14:00–15:00 or 15:30–16:30

If VP/CTO availability is tight we can do a staggered approach: a 25-minute exec intro followed immediately by a 35-minute technical demo with our engineering lead (no need for both execs to be present the full time).

I’ve cc’d Marissa (solutions) to help with materials and the calendar. Attached a short agenda and a few example slides.

Next step: which slot works best and who from Stellatek will attend?

Best,
Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Executive intro & demo — availability for VP/CTO?

Ben —

Thanks — appreciate the clear options. Quick update on attendees: our VP of Engineering (Anika Shah) is traveling the week of the 23rd and unavailable in the mornings. CTO Elena can join, but she has a hard stop at 11:00 on the 23rd. If you can do the staggered approach that would help: 25 min for exec/context (preferably with Anika, but if she can’t make it Elena can cover high level) then hand off to eng for the deeper demo.

Best options for us:
- Tue Jul 23, 10:00–11:00 (Elena can join until 11:00)
- Wed Jul 24, 15:30–16:30 (both Elena + Anika possibly available in afternoon)

Also: can you confirm whether the exec portion requires any pre-read or decision makers to sign off? We have procurement questions coming but we’ll surface those after the demo.

Thanks,
Rajiv

Perfect — thanks Rajiv. We can absolutely run the staggered flow so execs get the strategic highlights up front and the eng team sees the technical depth after. No mandatory pre-read for execs; a one-page benefits summary should be sufficient (attached).

I’ll tentatively hold Tue Jul 23, 10:00–11:00 PST and send a calendar invite with two internal pins: 10:00–10:25 exec summary, 10:25–11:00 technical deep-dive. If Elena needs to drop at 11:00 we’ll make sure the follow-up recording and action items are sent.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm demo runbook and engineer to lead the tech portion
- Stephanie: prepare the one-page exec summary and attach to the invite
- Rajiv/Elena: confirm final attendee list and any procurement stakeholders to loop for follow-ups

Attaching: demo-agenda.pdf (2 pages)

Ben
